howItWorks.title: Learn How PhotoGov Turns Your Selfie Into a 100% Compliant ID photo
howItWorks.lead1: PhotoGov is a modern technology platform that utilizes advanced image-processing algorithms to create 100% compliant ID photos. All passport-size pictures can now be produced from the comfort of your home or office, without the need to book, travel to, and wait at a professional studio.
howItWorks.lead2: Learn how our service has redefined the ID photo-making process — from creation and compliance checks to the technology that powers every step.
howItWorks.stepsTitle: Step‑by‑Step: From a Selfie to a Compliant ID Photo

steps.t: 1. Browse the PhotoGov Passport Photo Maker
steps.p: Click the “Get Your ID Photo” button or proceed directly to our free passport photo maker. No installation or account creation is required: the service works on desktop and mobile devices, in any browser, and is available 24/7.

On the start screen, choose the issuing country and document type. Behind this simple selector, there is a complex algorithm that will convert your original photo into an official photograph for this particular document.
Click a selfie with your phone, tablet, or laptop. Follow our on-screen instructions to upload and start processing your photo — everything is intuitive and easy!

steps.t: 4. Wait While the Image is Being Processed
steps.p: Once you’ve uploaded a selfie, PhotoGov sends it to the processing pipeline. Built‑in identification and compliance algorithms analyze the face and detect its key biometric points. Image size, crop, framing, head positioning, background, brightness, and contrast are adjusted to meet 100% of official requirements for the selected document type.

As an optional add-on, you can select the replacement of your casual clothing with a formal outfit. It’s a handy online service that allows you to convert any selfie into an official-looking ID photograph, regardless of what you’re wearing in the original picture.

If your application is of high priority, choose an expert verification for the processed image. Our senior compliance specialist examines the final image and provides recommendations on the quality and document‑photo compliance. Add this step as an extra layer of assurance for your submission.
In under 30 seconds, download your application-ready photo. You can select a digital file for online applications, or a printable PDF file for paper submissions.

howItWorks.note: while PhotoGov adjusts the technical parameters of the image, it does not change or retouch your facial features in any way — they remain exactly as in the original photo.
howItWorks.techTitle: Complex Technology Behind a User-Friendly Interface
tech: Behind the simple interface, PhotoGov is driven by a dedicated backend built to keep ID photo processing fast, reliable, and secure for your data. The platform runs on Tier III cloud servers — the same reliability class used in banking and healthcare systems — with 24/7 monitoring and automatic backups, so the service stays available, and your files remain protected even during peak load or maintenance.
Even when many users are online at once, the system redistributes the load across regions to keep your photo‑making process swift and stable.

When a photo is uploaded, it is analyzed in the browser and then processed on PhotoGov’s own GPU servers. These high‑performance servers use graphics processors to accelerate image processing, so all adjustments are applied in just a few seconds, even on a regular device. The algorithms correct the background, lighting, and size to meet official document standards, including face‑to‑frame ratio and color balance, so you don’t have to deal with technical photo rules yourself.
All image adjustments take place within PhotoGov’s secure environment; photos are never shared with external services, keeping your personal data safe and protected.

The final file is stored in encrypted cloud storage and delivered through a global CDN network for fast access anywhere. This means you can quickly download your photo whether you apply from home, the office, or while traveling.

Every step — from upload to download — is handled automatically and can be easily checked at any time. The system consistently follows international ID‑photo standards, which greatly reduces the chance of your application being rejected because of photo issues.
howItWorks.embassyTitle: ID Photos Made With Real Embassy Experience
embassy: PhotoGov collaborates with selected embassies to align its photo preparation process with current consular practices and document‑photo requirements.
Our team includes former consular and embassy staff, who apply their practical experience to refine the service and improve the likelihood of your ID photo acceptance.

PhotoGov is an independent service. We are not affiliated with any government, embassy, or consulate. All information on this website is based on official government requirements and verified primary sources. Final acceptance of the photo is determined solely by the issuing authority.

whyChooseUs.title: 11 Reasons to Trust Your ID Photos to PhotoGov Online Photo-Maker
whyChooseUs.lead1: Behind every approved document is a photo that meets a strict set of technical, biometric, and legal requirements. To trust an online service to create an official photo, you, as a user, must be 100% sure that your final image will meet all government guidelines and ease the application process.
whyChooseUs.lead2: Here are 11 reasons why over 2 million users rely on PhotoGov for their ID photos.
whyChooseUs.learnPricingTail: about our pricing policy and subscription options.

reasons.t: 1. One Service for All Official ID Photos
ps: PhotoGov supports photos for 900+ essential international document types — from passports to national IDs, from visas to boat licenses. Simply choose the country and type, and our system automatically applies the correct biometric and technical settings for that particular photograph.
PhotoGov uses built‑in identification and compliance algorithms based on the essential international regulations:
bullets: Government requirements at the country level. All ID photos must adhere to the guidelines of the issuing jurisdictions: the U.S. Department of State, Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, the UK Home Office, and other international ministries and consulates.

Global biometric ID photo standards. On the global level, the ID photo specifications are defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Document 9303, which sets biometric standards for passport and visa photographs.

ISO/IEC 19794‑5 — another international standard that specifies how biometric face images should be captured, cropped, and stored to ensure smooth identification both by officers and automated systems.

When you select a document type, PhotoGov automatically applies the relevant authority’s instructions and checks the image against these ICAO and ISO/IEC criteria for head size, eye position, background, and image quality.

ps: PhotoGov works in any browser, on any device, or operating system. You don’t need to create an account, remember a password, or install an app. Just open our website, select your country and document, upload a photo, wait while the system processes the image, choose add-on services, and download the final image.

PhotoGov is a free passport photo maker for most countries. In a limited number of locations, the photo service is available on a paid basis. However, the first photo is usually available at no charge, and additional photos are priced well below a typical commercial studio. Plus, you don’t need to leave your home or office to make them.

PhotoGov applies built‑in identification and compliance algorithms to align your original photo with official technical and visual requirements. Our system straightens the head, adjusts brightness and contrast, cleans the background, and scales the face to the required range for the selected document.
As an add‑on service, you can switch the clothing in your photo to a formal outfit, as required by some authorities, or simply to avoid changing what you are wearing when taking a selfie.
The full process — from upload to final file — takes less than 30 seconds. As soon as processing is complete, you can download:
A digital file for online applications, and a print‑ready layout for a photo lab or home printer.
Producing a compliant image in just 30 seconds, PhotoGov saves both time and money and is particularly helpful when you urgently need a photo for an upcoming application or appointment.

The PhotoGov service is available 24/7, from anywhere in the world. You can prepare a photo at home before visiting a local visa agency, from a hotel room while submitting documents through a consulate abroad, or from your office, if you’re preparing business paperwork for official submission. Our service conveniently and reliably works everywhere, eliminating the need for a studio visit.

PhotoGov combines software checks with human expertise. Our dedicated team tracks official updates, maintains templates, and tests generated images in real submission scenarios. For key document types, automated validation is complemented by human verification: our senior specialists review your photos and provide their expert feedback. This dual approach gives our users peace of mind during a stressful application process.

reasons.t: 9. Constant Updates to the Regulatory Changes
ps: Official authorities constantly update ID photo specifications: background shades, head‑height ranges, file sizes, and other details change over time. The PhotoGov team monitors official sources and updates both the templates and the resource pages when new instructions are published. Behind a simple document selector on our platform, there is always the 100% checked, most current version of the official requirements.

PhotoGov operates on the same infrastructure and reliability class that is used in banking and healthcare. It includes redundant power and connectivity support, 24/7 monitoring, and automated backups. For you, this means that the website loads consistently, processing is stable, and your generated photo remains available for download during the allotted time.

When you use our service, you don’t need to worry about your data safety. From upload to download, your photo is processed within a single, controlled ecosystem. Images are transmitted over encrypted connections, handled on PhotoGov servers, and are not sent to any third parties. Generated photos are stored in encrypted form for a limited period, just long enough for you to get your compliant photo. After that, they are deleted under internal retention rules.

subscription.t: 4.4. Eligibility for a Full Subscription Refund
subscription.p: A full refund of the most recent Subscription charge may be issued in the following cases:

usCompliance.title: PhotoGov’s Compliance with the US ID Photo Regulations
usCompliance.sub: Learn about the PhotoGov service compliance with the US ID photo policies & digital modification restrictions
paras: PhotoGov.net fully complies with the biometric standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and the official requirements of the U.S. Department of State for passport and identification photos. Our system aligns with all recognized frameworks governing image dimensions, proportions, and data handling for official U.S. documents.

Each uploaded photo is processed through a secure, automated workflow hosted on PhotoGov’s own GPU servers. The system adjusts size, framing, and background according to the specifications defined for U.S. passport and ID formats.

Processing takes place entirely within PhotoGov’s infrastructure, without transferring any images to third-party services. This ensures accuracy, confidentiality, and complete compliance with the official standards.
usCompliance.policyTitle: U.S. ID Photo Digital Alteration Policy & Our Service
policy: The U.S. Department of State strictly prohibits any digital modification of ID, passport, and visa photos. This includes the use of software, apps, or AI tools to retouch, reshape, brighten, or alter facial features and backgrounds.

PhotoGov.net provides only technical services, such as sizing and cropping, to meet official specifications. We do not modify or enhance images in any way that changes a person’s natural appearance or the authenticity of the photograph.
alterations: Cropping or retouching the background in a way that changes the outline of the head, face, or neck
Digitally reshaping the face or body to appear thinner or smoother
Applying filters that alter color tones, skin texture, or lighting
Removing “red eye” or other natural reflections that were present in the original image
usCompliance.alterationsNote: These practices are considered violations of U.S. Department of State photo requirements and will result in the photo being rejected during passport processing.
usCompliance.sourceState: The U.S. Department of State — Bureau of Consular Affairs
